6/S0.subgoal: Identify the four phases of virtual reality's historical evolution and their approximate time spans.

6/S1.subgoal: Describe the pre-computer early-era developments that anticipated immersive virtual reality.

6/S2.subgoal: Describe the key developments of VR's formative years from the 1950s to the late 1980s, including HMDs, immersive devices, haptics, and the popularization of the term virtual reality.

6/S3.subgoal: Describe the key developments of VR's modern phase from 1990 to 2015, including CAVE, software tools, HMD advances, and the Oculus Rift.

6/S4.subgoal: Describe the growth phase of VR from 2016 onward, including commercial headsets, the Metaverse term, and the expectation of continued development.

6/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next part on augmented reality history.
